comments.text: Guys, for everyone that can't get 3D to work, I spent 3 hours to finally find out that, after you download the BSL settings file, be sure that you rename it to be the same as your BSL version, in this case is version 8, so copy the name from the bsl shaders to the txt file. After that, open options -> video settings -> shaders, and be sure to turn on both normal map and specular map, these are the settings that I was missing, and it finally looks 3D!

Took me a whole day just to find out that I can't use these mods because I have so called 'Bedrock' edition (Windows 10 edition, a NON-java edition) which is not the same as the java-edition. Then I actually went downloading so I could run jar-files, after the fact that I already tried to un-jar files with 'winrar' and then didn't find any way to install them to minecraft. After this I tried to manually move these folders to their right folder, but Microsoft store don't put those files in an easy place, also there is no mods folder... Then I realized that there is no 'MODS'-button in this so called 'BEDROCK' edition so there was no reason to have a mod folder because there is no mod button and no reason to download java-program because the jar-file is complaining that it cannot find Minecraft 1.17.1... so I tried to locate an exe-file or the correct folder for it to be located, but couldn't find it. I then try to find solutions on both the mod pages and on Youtube, but not many of these includes these HD resolution textures that are represented in this video (which are of course the ones that I want to have installed), nay, they include the skins that are purchaseable in the stores, which are NOT the same as these VERY HIGH HD textures. But I was pointed to these videos and game blogs, over and over and over again. Then I find myself not having the same version which is fine because it should work roughly the same, I guess I am the fool for not knowing that there are two versions of Minecraft, but this I knew, what I didn't know is that they cannot communicate, well I found out later on and that is reasonable, but what I dont get is why this isn't stated in this video, that I should know that these mods are only for java verision. Nowhere on the page does it say that it is for java version only. So I guess there is an huge assumption here, that I should know that these packs only works on java version, and even then you have to have some tinkering before rtx tracing is even possible on the java version, even when no mentioning of it in either your page or in this video.

TL;DR
THIS DOES NOT WORK FOR 'BEDROCK'-edition OF MINECRAFT!
Also, do you want the Minecraft launcher on bedrock edition? Well, YOU CAN'T, sux to be u
